sections.heading: What a High-Mileage BMW Engine Rebuild Involves

blocks.html: When a BMW engine has covered high mileage - typically over 100,000 miles - wear is distributed across the entire unit, not just a single component. A high-mileage rebuild addresses every area of wear, restoring the engine to a serviceable condition with a [12-month unlimited-mileage warranty](/bmw-engine-warranty).

items: Full strip-down to bare block and cylinder head
Comprehensive measurement of every component against factory service limits
Machining assessment - boring, honing, and grinding where required
Replacement of all wear items: bearings, piston rings, gaskets, seals, timing components
Ancillary attention: oil pump, water pump, and other ancillaries assessed and replaced if worn
Reassembly with new fasteners, torqued to factory specifications

items.q: What mileage is considered high for a BMW engine?
items.a: We typically consider over 100,000 miles as high mileage. However, BMW engines are known for strong blocks that can handle multiple rebuilds - the key is a comprehensive inspection to determine what can be machined and what must be replaced.

items.q: What components are replaced during a high-mileage rebuild?
items.a: All wear items are replaced: bearings, piston rings, gaskets, seals, timing components, and fasteners. Ancillaries like the oil pump and water pump are assessed and replaced if worn.

items.q: How long does a high-mileage rebuild take?
items.a: Typically 3-5 working days, depending on the extent of machining required. We aim to keep you mobile with a courtesy vehicle where possible.
Every rebuild comes with a [12-month unlimited-mileage warranty](/bmw-engine-warranty) covering parts and labour. Recovery from £70 is available if needed.
